canada.title: Air force pays tribute to retiring CC-130H Hercules planes
canada.summary: Royal Canadian Air Force personnel in Winnipeg bid farewell Saturday to the military branch’s last remaining CC-130H Hercules planes — “workhorses” that crews flew in seemingly countless combat, rescue and transport operations.

canada.title: Pedestrian dies after being struck by vehicle at crosswalk
canada.summary: A pedestrian has died after being struck by a pickup truck at a Winnipeg crosswalk Friday evening.

canada.title: Convicted B.C. murderer who attended McGill's faculty of law now back in custody
canada.summary: Jeffrey George Ewert, a convicted murderer who has stirred controversy while attending law courses at McGill University, is back in custody while authorities look more closely at his case.

canada.title: York police officer facing slew of charges, including breach of trust
canada.summary: A York Regional Police officer, who recently worked as a front-line patrol sergeant, has been charged with several offences, according to police.

canada.title: Voters head to the polls in B.C.’s 2026 snap election. Live updates here.
canada.summary: After weeks of political attacks, campaign promises and gaffes, it’s decision day in B.C.’s 2026 snap election.

canada.title: Montrealers rally against alleged humiliation of unhoused, racialized citizens by police officers
canada.summary: The protest, which began around 3 p.m., was in response to news earlier this month that two police officers who work at the downtown station were suspended in August for alleged acts of humiliation directed at unhoused and racialized people.

canada.title: Family history in wool: Jean Ketch enters her rugs into N.B. Mat Registry
canada.summary: Jean Ketch registered her 1988 heraldic rug with the N.B. Mat Registry, ensuring her family’s story in wool is preserved for future generations.

canada.title: Calgary family finds box of Pokémon cards valued at roughly $48,000
canada.summary: A Calgary family is giving thanks after they discovered an old box of Pokémon cards worth roughly $48,000 during Thanksgiving dinner.

canada.title: BC election 2026: Find your riding, local candidates
canada.summary: Use the Global News riding look-up tool to find your riding and candidates in the 2026 provincial election. BC NDP leader David Eby called the snap election in September.

canada.title: Athletes hit the East Coast Trail — even in tough weather — for annual 50K race
canada.summary: Despite the rain and heavy winds, about 200 people ran a 50-kilometre race along the East Coast Trail on Saturday.

canada.title: Sask. Crime Stoppers programs pause tip intake due to national data breach
canada.summary: A news release issued jointly from Crime Stoppers agencies in Saskatchewan confirmed the impact of the national leak in Saskatchewan, saying "the stolen data included information that could potentially identify some people who provided tips."

canada.title: Regina Firefighters extinguish fire at Hill Avenue building
canada.summary: The building, which the Saskatchewan Health Authority (SHA) uses as storage, had heavy smoke and fire coming from the roof.

canada.title: 'Quite frustrating': Demand surges for N.S. fall vaccine appointments
canada.summary: After a week of trying to book COVID-19 and flu shots for her and her husband, Sue Earle finally succeeded, but they must wait until Nov. 17. Nova Scotia health officials say vaccine demand has been strong, but new appointments are opening up regularly.

canada.title: Duelling petitions highlight rift over paroled murderer at McGill law school
canada.summary: Students at McGill University's law faculty remain divided over the presence of a convicted murderer in the classroom, with a new counter-petition outlining why some students feel unsafe and don't want him in their presence.

canada.title: Halifax Water breach raises questions about ethical hacking
canada.summary: A third-party security tip dismissed as spam by Halifax Water is raising questions about ethical hacking and how organizations handle unauthorized vulnerability reports.

canada.title: First Nations leaders voice priorities ahead of historic meeting in Ottawa
canada.summary: First Nations leaders are preparing for a historic meeting with Prime Minister Mark Carney and the nation’s premiers, the first of its kind in more than two decades.

canada.title: QUIZ: Watching out for bears
canada.summary: As temperatures cool, bears are preparing to hibernate

canada.title: Former Yukon chief land claims negotiator and territorial court judge Barry Stuart dies at 83
canada.summary: An adopted citizen of Carcross/Tagish First Nation’s Deisheetaan clan, Stuart helped pioneer restorative justice practices in the territory and was also at the forefront of the Yukon's pivotal land claims negotiations in the '80s.
